description: Main entry script for the openclaw project, handling Node.js version checks, module cache, dynamic imports, and CLI help output.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses a raw Node.js version string into major and minor numbers.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given Node.js version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Ensures the current Node.js version is supported, exits if not.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a module not found error.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a direct module not found error for a specific specifier.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Attempts to import and install process warning filters from specific modules.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Attempts to dynamically import a module, returns success status.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a URL specifier exists.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Builds an error message indicating missing build output and suggests build steps.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Checks if CLI was invoked with help flags.

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed root help text from a JSON file.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to output the root help text, either precomputed or via module.
